method.source: SEC EDGAR: Schedule 13E-3 transaction statements and the proxy statements attached to or filed with them (dealType take-private), and DEFM14A / DEFM14C definitive merger proxies found through the quarterly form index (dealType public merger); XBRL company facts for the target's financials
method.acquirer: for a take-private, the buyer a page names from the 13E-3 filer list; for a merger proxy, the first named party of the merger agreement sentence that is neither the target nor a merger vehicle (acquirerBasis is the sentence), null where the parties are named only by defined term
method.status: ok, no-offer (read, no per-share cash figure stated), no-consideration (an acquirer-side vote: the filer's own holders voted on issuing shares), rejected (a blank-check shell or a fund reorganisation, not a precedent transaction) or error
method.announced: the merger agreement date as stated in the transaction statement; the 13E-3 filing date when no agreement date is stated (announcedBasis)
method.offerPrice: per-share cash consideration as stated in the filing, the most frequently stated figure (offerBasis is the phrase matched)
method.premiums: as stated in the filing, to the closing price before announcement, the 30-day VWAP and the 52-week high (premiumBasis is the sentence matched); unaffectedPrice, vwap30 and high52 are offer / (1 + premium)
method.financials: USD millions; sharesOut from the transaction statement when the company facts carry no count at announcement; LTM to the last fiscal period end on or before announcement (fiscal year + YTD - prior YTD), EBITDA = operating income + D&A, net debt = debt - cash and short-term investments at the same balance sheet; sharesOut = cover-page shares (dei) at the last cover date on or before announcement, millions
method.values: equityValue = offerPrice x sharesOut; ev = equityValue + netDebt; dealValue = the aggregate value from the filing-fee table, kept as a cross-check
method.flags: rows whose figures fail a sanity check (stock in the consideration, equity value far from the fee-table value, a premium above 150%, multiples out of range) are kept but flagged, and select() leaves them out
